title: 第691章 战斗白热化第690章 渎怪
slug: 骑士先生魔王真的不存在啊
lines: 夏提拉回头看一下胡布里斯，细长的眼眸半眯着，轻声吟唱魔法咒语的同时，魔杖在她手上挥舞转圈，画出了一道魔法阵。
胡布里斯瞳孔一颤，快速施法，释放雷电攻击夏提拉，企图中断魔法施展。
夏提拉的魔法阵恰好绘制完成，抽出一只手来，从储物空间放出了一些奇怪植物种子。
植物种子迅速睁眼，头顶破出绿芽，像翅膀一样扇动，主动冲向胡布里斯释放的魔法。
噼啪一声，雷鸣落下，植物种子没有受到任何影响，继续冲向胡布里斯。
“魔女的手段比起我这个炼金魔法师只多不少啊。”胡布里斯感慨着，快速拿出魔法卷轴，展开几道屏障，挡住飞行的植物种子。
一阵爆炸之后，魔力形成的烟雾挡住胡布里斯，夏提拉趁此机会将魔力输给提姆。
魔力的主动输入让提姆回过神来，左右环顾，急忙飞到夏提拉的面前。
“亲爱的，拜托你了，之后再跟姆莉解释吧。”
提姆说完，不等回答，化作一道白色流光冲向世界树。
噗的一声，提姆撞在树上，消失无踪。
魔力烟雾正好被胡布里斯用风魔法驱散，让胡布里斯看见了提姆钻进树中的这一幕。
胡布里斯有些惊讶的，又有些困惑，眯着眼睛盯着树干打量片刻，退了两步。
胡布里斯的小动作被夏提拉注意到，魔法瞬间发动，地面钻出的树根纠缠在一起，变成一条木龙扑向胡布里斯。
风魔法降临战场，与巨大的木龙撞在一起，同时甩着不少风刃攻向夏提拉。
夏提拉挥动魔杖，大地颤动，一道巨大的土墙升起……
地下，昏暗的通道内，有淡淡的微光出现在各通道的终点。
一株消瘦的树苗扎在土地里，不均匀的金光顺着树的脉络缓缓向上爬动，点缀着匮乏的树叶。
蜜尔菲拉恰好就在一株树苗前，看着树苗的眼神有些不自信。
蜜尔菲拉问身边的人蚁：“可以确定伪世界树树苗真的起到作用了吗？”
“女王陛下，从树苗的反应来看，应当是成功了，胡布里斯直面着危险，没理由在这个时候欺骗我们。”
蜜尔菲拉看着不断汲取地幔能量的伪世界树树苗，头顶的触角轻轻抖动，好像在追忆着什么。
她将手放到胸口，能感受到体内有一股独特的能量，在与伪世界树树苗产生共鸣。
蜜尔菲拉控制体内的能量向外释放，在她心口的位置，一道蓝光穿透肌肤，让蜜尔菲拉的身体散发光芒。
“女王陛下？！”
周围人蚁慌张地围着蜜尔菲拉，担心她遭遇什么危险。
“没事，这是力量的共鸣。”蜜尔菲拉回答着，缓慢伸手触摸伪世界树树苗。
“胡布里斯让我们砍那么多树用来研究，并制作了这些树苗，既然它们能像真的世界树一样吸收地脉的力量，那我们也应该能够吸收它们的力量。”
追求力量壮大虫群的野心在蜜尔菲拉的心底之深，她单手刺入树苗树干里，将地脉的能量吸取到自己身上。
那些本该是金色能量接触她的身体忽然改为蓝色，发着光芒，从手臂流向心脏。
“月亮湖。”蜜尔菲拉不禁念到一个地名。
“什么？陛下？”周围的人蚁一头雾水。
content_en:
Shatila looked back at Hubris, her slender eyes half-closed. While chanting the magic spell softly, she waved the wand in circles on her hand, drawing a magic circle.
Hubris's pupils trembled, and he quickly cast spells, releasing thunder and lightning to attack Shatila, trying to interrupt the magic.
Shatila's magic circle happened to be drawn, so she took out a hand and released some strange plant seeds from the storage space.
The plant seeds quickly opened their eyes, and green shoots sprouted from the top of their heads. They flapped like wings and actively rushed towards the magic released by Hubris.
There was a crackle and thunder, but the plant seeds were not affected in any way and continued to rush towards Hubris.
"The witch's methods are only much more powerful than those of an alchemical magician like me." Hubris sighed, quickly taking out the magic scroll and unfolding several barriers to block the flying plant seeds.
After an explosion, the smoke formed by magic blocked Hubris, and Shatila took this opportunity to lose the magic to Tim.
The active input of magic power brought Tim back to his senses, looked around, and hurriedly flew to Shatila.
"My dear, please, please explain to Mli later."
After Tim finished speaking, without waiting for an answer, he turned into a white stream of light and rushed towards the World Tree.
With a pop, Tim hit the tree and disappeared without a trace.
The magic smoke was dispersed by Hubris with wind magic, allowing Hubris to see Tim getting into the tree.
Hubris was a little surprised and confused. He squinted his eyes and stared at the tree trunk for a moment, then took two steps back.
Hubris's little movement was noticed by Shatila, and the magic was activated instantly. The tree roots that emerged from the ground became entangled, turning into a wooden dragon and pounced on Hubris.
Wind magic descended on the battlefield and collided with the huge wooden dragon, while swinging many wind blades towards Shatila.
Shatila waved her magic wand, the earth trembled, and a huge earth wall rose...
Underground, in the dim passages, a faint light appears at the end of each passage.
A thin sapling was rooted in the ground, and uneven golden light slowly crawled upward along the veins of the tree, dotted with the scarce leaves.
Milfila happened to be in front of a sapling, looking at the sapling with a somewhat unconfident look.
Milfila asked the human ant beside her: "Are you sure that the pseudo-World Tree saplings really work?"
"Your Majesty, judging from the reaction of the saplings, it should be a success. Hubris is facing the danger, and there is no reason to deceive us at this time."
Milfila looked at the Pseudo World Tree sapling that was constantly absorbing energy from the earth's mantle. The tentacles above her head trembled slightly, as if she was reminiscing about something.
She put her hand on her chest and could feel a unique energy in her body, resonating with the pseudo-World Tree sapling.
Melphira controlled the energy in her body to release outward. At the position of her heart, a blue light penetrated the skin, making Melphira's body shine.
"Her Majesty the Queen?!"
The people around her gathered around Melphira in a panic, worried that she might be in danger.
"It's okay, this is the resonance of power." Milfila replied, slowly reaching out to touch the pseudo-world tree sapling.
"Hubris asked us to cut down so many trees for research and make these saplings. Since they can absorb the power of the earth's veins like the real World Tree, we should also be able to absorb their power."
The ambition to pursue power and expand the insect swarm was deep in Melfila's heart. She pierced the trunk of the sapling with one hand and absorbed the energy of the earth's veins into herself.
The golden energy that was supposed to touch her body suddenly changed to blue, glowing, flowing from her arms to her heart.
"Moon Lake." Milfila couldn't help but read a place name.
"What? Your Majesty?" The people around were confused.
